78	variable {S : Scheme.{u}}

80	/-- **The bridge between the Over-category product and Scheme-level pullbacks.** For two
81	objects `X, T` of `Over S`, the underlying scheme of the cartesian-monoidal product
82	`(X ⊗ T).left` together with the two projections is the fibre product of `X.hom` and
83	`T.hom`. This is the single point where `C ⊗ Spec A` is unfolded to `Limits.pullback`;
84	everything downstream consumes this `IsPullback` datum. -/
85	theorem Over.isPullback_left (X T : Over S) :
86	    IsPullback (fst X T).left (snd X T).left X.hom T.hom := by
87	  simp only [Over.fst_left, Over.snd_left]
88	  exact IsPullback.of_hasPullback X.hom T.hom
89	
90	end Bridge

94	variable (k : Type u) [CommRing k] (A : Type u) [CommRing A] [Algebra k A]
95	
96	/-- `Spec A` as an object of `Over (Spec k)`, for a commutative `k`-algebra `A`. -/
97	noncomputable abbrev overSpec : Over (Spec (.of k)) :=
98	  Over.mk (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap k A)))

101	lemma overSpec_left : (overSpec k A).left = Spec (.of A) := rfl
102	
103	@[simp]
104	lemma overSpec_hom :
105	    (overSpec k A).hom = Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap k A)) := rfl

107	/-- The underlying scheme of `overSpec k A` is affine (it is `Spec A`); form usable where
108	`IsAffineOpen (⊤ : (overSpec k A).left.Opens)` is expected. -/
109	lemma isAffineOpen_top_overSpec : IsAffineOpen (⊤ : (overSpec k A).left.Opens) :=
110	  isAffineOpen_top (Spec (.of A))

112	/-- Over a field, `Spec A ⟶ Spec k` is flat, for every commutative `k`-algebra `A`. -/
113	instance flat_overSpec_hom {k : Type u} [Field k] (A : Type u) [CommRing A] [Algebra k A] :
114	    Flat (overSpec k A).hom :=
115	  Flat.SpecMap_iff.mpr (by
116	    rw [CommRingCat.hom_ofHom]
117	    exact RingHom.flat_algebraMap_iff.mpr inferInstance)

121	section Pushout
122	
123	variable {k : Type u} [Field k] (X T : Over (Spec (.of k)))
124	
125	/-- **Base change of sections, affine opens.** For `X, T` over `Spec k` with `T.left`
126	affine and an affine open `V ⊆ X.left`, the square of section rings
127	
128	```
129	Γ(Spec k, ⊤) ⟶ Γ(X.left, V)
130	     |               |
131	     ↓               ↓
132	Γ(T.left, ⊤) ⟶ Γ((X ⊗ T).left, fst⁻¹ V)
133	```
134	
135	is a pushout of commutative rings. No flatness is needed in the affine case. -/
136	theorem Over.isPushout_sections_of_isAffineOpen
137	    (hT : IsAffineOpen (⊤ : T.left.Opens)) {V : X.left.Opens} (hV : IsAffineOpen V) :
138	    IsPushout (X.hom.appLE ⊤ V (le_top.trans (Scheme.Hom.preimage_top X.hom).ge))
139	      (T.hom.appLE ⊤ ⊤ (Scheme.Hom.preimage_top T.hom).ge)
140	      ((fst X T).left.appLE V ((fst X T).left ⁻¹ᵁ V) le_rfl)
141	      ((snd X T).left.appLE ⊤ ((fst X T).left ⁻¹ᵁ V)
142	        (le_top.trans (Scheme.Hom.preimage_top (snd X T).left).ge)) := by
143	  have hUST : (⊤ : T.left.Opens) ≤ T.hom ⁻¹ᵁ (⊤ : (Spec (.of k)).Opens) :=
144	    (Scheme.Hom.preimage_top T.hom).ge
145	  have hUSX : V ≤ X.hom ⁻¹ᵁ (⊤ : (Spec (.of k)).Opens) :=
146	    le_top.trans (Scheme.Hom.preimage_top X.hom).ge
147	  have hUY : (fst X T).left ⁻¹ᵁ V =
148	      (fst X T).left ⁻¹ᵁ V ⊓ (snd X T).left ⁻¹ᵁ (⊤ : T.left.Opens) := by
149	    rw [Scheme.Hom.preimage_top, inf_top_eq]
150	  have h := isIso_pushoutSection_of_isAffineOpen (Over.isPullback_left X T) hUST hUSX hUY
151	    (isAffineOpen_top _) hT hV
152	  exact (isIso_pushoutSection_iff _ _ _ _).mp h
153	
154	/-- **Base change of sections, qcqs opens.** For `X, T` over `Spec k` with `T.hom` flat,
155	`T.left` affine, and a quasi-compact quasi-separated open `V ⊆ X.left` (e.g. an
156	intersection of two affine opens of a separated scheme, or all of a proper curve), the
157	square of section rings
158	
159	```
160	Γ(Spec k, ⊤) ⟶ Γ(X.left, V)
161	     |               |
162	     ↓               ↓
163	Γ(T.left, ⊤) ⟶ Γ((X ⊗ T).left, fst⁻¹ V)
164	```
165	
166	is a pushout of commutative rings. Flatness of `T.hom` holds automatically for
167	`T = overSpec k A` (`AlgebraicGeometry.flat_overSpec_hom`). -/
168	theorem Over.isPushout_sections [Flat T.hom] (hT : IsAffineOpen (⊤ : T.left.Opens))
169	    {V : X.left.Opens} (hV : IsCompact (V : Set X.left))
170	    (hV' : IsQuasiSeparated (V : Set X.left)) :
171	    IsPushout (X.hom.appLE ⊤ V (le_top.trans (Scheme.Hom.preimage_top X.hom).ge))
172	      (T.hom.appLE ⊤ ⊤ (Scheme.Hom.preimage_top T.hom).ge)
173	      ((fst X T).left.appLE V ((fst X T).left ⁻¹ᵁ V) le_rfl)
174	      ((snd X T).left.appLE ⊤ ((fst X T).left ⁻¹ᵁ V)
175	        (le_top.trans (Scheme.Hom.preimage_top (snd X T).left).ge)) := by
176	  have hUST : (⊤ : T.left.Opens) ≤ T.hom ⁻¹ᵁ (⊤ : (Spec (.of k)).Opens) :=
177	    (Scheme.Hom.preimage_top T.hom).ge
178	  have hUSX : V ≤ X.hom ⁻¹ᵁ (⊤ : (Spec (.of k)).Opens) :=
179	    le_top.trans (Scheme.Hom.preimage_top X.hom).ge
180	  have hUY : (fst X T).left ⁻¹ᵁ V =
181	      (fst X T).left ⁻¹ᵁ V ⊓ (snd X T).left ⁻¹ᵁ (⊤ : T.left.Opens) := by
182	    rw [Scheme.Hom.preimage_top, inf_top_eq]
183	  have h := isIso_pushoutSection_of_isQuasiSeparated_of_flat_right
184	    (Over.isPullback_left X T) hUST hUSX hUY (isAffineOpen_top _) hT hV hV'
185	  exact (isIso_pushoutSection_iff _ _ _ _).mp h
186	
187	end Pushout

189	section TensorFace
190	
191	variable {k : Type u} [Field k] (X : Over (Spec (.of k)))
192	
193	/-- The `k`-algebra structure on `Γ(X.left, V)` for `X` an object of `Over (Spec k)`:
194	restriction of scalars along the structure morphism `X.hom`. Deliberately **not** a global
195	instance (it would overlap with mathlib's `Algebra R Γ(Spec R, U)` instances; cf. the house
196	rule for `Scheme.overModule`). Activate it locally with
197	`attribute [local instance] Over.sectionsAlgebra` — the statements of this file mention it
198	explicitly, so consumers must activate the same instance for the statements to elaborate
199	identically. -/
200	@[reducible] noncomputable def Over.sectionsAlgebra (V : X.left.Opens) :
201	    Algebra k Γ(X.left, V) :=
202	  ((Scheme.ΓSpecIso (.of k)).inv ≫
203	    X.hom.appLE ⊤ V (le_top.trans (Scheme.Hom.preimage_top X.hom).ge)).hom.toAlgebra
204	
205	attribute [local instance] Over.sectionsAlgebra
206	
207	/-- Unfolding lemma for `Over.sectionsAlgebra`: the algebra structure map, as a morphism of
208	`CommRingCat`, is the structure morphism of `X` on sections. -/
209	lemma Over.ofHom_algebraMap_sections (V : X.left.Opens) :
210	    CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap k Γ(X.left, V)) =
211	      (Scheme.ΓSpecIso (.of k)).inv ≫
212	        X.hom.appLE ⊤ V (le_top.trans (Scheme.Hom.preimage_top X.hom).ge) :=
213	  rfl
214	
215	/-- The algebra structure maps of `Over.sectionsAlgebra` intertwine restriction. -/
216	lemma Over.algebraMap_sections_comp_res {V W : X.left.Opens} (h : W ≤ V) :
217	    CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap k Γ(X.left, V)) ≫ X.left.presheaf.map (homOfLE h).op =
218	      CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap k Γ(X.left, W)) := by
219	  rw [Over.ofHom_algebraMap_sections, Over.ofHom_algebraMap_sections, Category.assoc,
220	    Scheme.Hom.appLE_map]
221	
222	/-- Restriction of sections along `W ≤ V` as a `k`-algebra homomorphism (with the
223	`Over.sectionsAlgebra` structures). -/
224	noncomputable def Over.resAlgHom {V W : X.left.Opens} (h : W ≤ V) :
225	    Γ(X.left, V) →ₐ[k] Γ(X.left, W) where
226	  __ := (X.left.presheaf.map (homOfLE h).op).hom
227	  commutes' r := congr($(Over.algebraMap_sections_comp_res X h).hom r)
228	
229	@[simp]
230	lemma Over.resAlgHom_apply {V W : X.left.Opens} (h : W ≤ V) (s : Γ(X.left, V)) :
231	    Over.resAlgHom X h s = X.left.presheaf.map (homOfLE h).op s :=
232	  rfl
233	
234	variable (A : Type u) [CommRing A] [Algebra k A]
235	
236	/-- **Base change of sections with the `k`/`A` corners.** For a qcqs open `V ⊆ X.left`, the
237	square
238	
239	```
240	   k    ⟶ Γ(X.left, V)
241	   |         |
242	   ↓         ↓
243	   A    ⟶ Γ((X ⊗ Spec A).left, fst⁻¹ V)
244	```
245	
246	(with the `Over.sectionsAlgebra` structure map on top and the second-projection pullback
247	`A ≅ Γ(Spec A, ⊤) ⟶ Γ(..)` at the bottom) is a pushout of commutative rings. -/
248	theorem Over.isPushout_algebraMap_sections {V : X.left.Opens}
249	    (hV : IsCompact (V : Set X.left)) (hV' : IsQuasiSeparated (V : Set X.left)) :
250	    IsPushout (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap k Γ(X.left, V)))
251	      (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap k A))
252	      ((fst X (overSpec k A)).left.appLE V ((fst X (overSpec k A)).left ⁻¹ᵁ V) le_rfl)
253	      ((Scheme.ΓSpecIso (.of A)).inv ≫
254	        (snd X (overSpec k A)).left.appLE ⊤ ((fst X (overSpec k A)).left ⁻¹ᵁ V)
255	          (le_top.trans (Scheme.Hom.preimage_top (snd X (overSpec k A)).left).ge)) := by
256	  refine (Over.isPushout_sections X (overSpec k A)
257	    (isAffineOpen_top_overSpec k A) hV hV').of_iso
258	    (Scheme.ΓSpecIso (.of k)) (Iso.refl _) (Scheme.ΓSpecIso (.of A)) (Iso.refl _)
259	    ?_ ?_ ?_ ?_
260	  · simp only [Iso.refl_hom, Category.comp_id]
261	    rw [Over.ofHom_algebraMap_sections, Iso.hom_inv_id_assoc]
262	  · have h : (overSpec k A).hom.appLE ⊤ ⊤ (Scheme.Hom.preimage_top (overSpec k A).hom).ge =
263	        (overSpec k A).hom.appTop :=
264	      Scheme.Hom.appLE_eq_app _
265	    rw [h, overSpec_hom]
266	    exact Scheme.ΓSpecIso_naturality (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap k A))
267	  · simp only [Iso.refl_hom, Category.comp_id, Category.id_comp]
268	  · rw [Iso.refl_hom, Category.comp_id]
269	    exact (Iso.hom_inv_id_assoc _ _).symm
270	
271	/-- **Base change of sections, comparison isomorphism** (in `CommRingCat`):
272	`Γ(X.left, V) ⊗[k] A ≅ Γ((X ⊗ Spec A).left, fst⁻¹ V)` for a qcqs open `V ⊆ X.left`.
273	On pure tensors this is the product of the two pullbacks; see
274	`Over.sectionsBaseChange_tmul`. -/
275	noncomputable def Over.sectionsBaseChangeIso {V : X.left.Opens}
276	    (hV : IsCompact (V : Set X.left)) (hV' : IsQuasiSeparated (V : Set X.left)) :
277	    CommRingCat.of (Γ(X.left, V) ⊗[k] A) ≅
278	      Γ((X ⊗ overSpec k A).left, (fst X (overSpec k A)).left ⁻¹ᵁ V) :=
279	  (CommRingCat.isPushout_tensorProduct k Γ(X.left, V) A).isoIsPushout _ _
280	    (Over.isPushout_algebraMap_sections X A hV hV')
281	
282	/-- **Base change of sections** (brick 1 of the separatedness ledger, design §4.4): for `X`
283	over the field `k`, a commutative `k`-algebra `A` and a qcqs open `V ⊆ X.left`, the ring
284	equivalence `Γ(X.left, V) ⊗[k] A ≃+* Γ((X ⊗ Spec A).left, fst⁻¹ V)`, sending `s ⊗ a` to
285	the product of the pullbacks of `s` (along the first projection) and of `a` (along the
286	second). The `k`-algebra structure on `Γ(X.left, V)` is `Over.sectionsAlgebra`. -/
287	noncomputable def Over.sectionsBaseChange {V : X.left.Opens}
288	    (hV : IsCompact (V : Set X.left)) (hV' : IsQuasiSeparated (V : Set X.left)) :
289	    Γ(X.left, V) ⊗[k] A ≃+*
290	      Γ((X ⊗ overSpec k A).left, (fst X (overSpec k A)).left ⁻¹ᵁ V) :=
291	  (Over.sectionsBaseChangeIso X A hV hV').commRingCatIsoToRingEquiv
292	
293	/-- `Over.sectionsBaseChange` for an affine open `V` (affine opens are qcqs) — the form
294	pinned by design §4.4 brick 1. -/
295	noncomputable def Over.sectionsBaseChangeOfIsAffineOpen {V : X.left.Opens}
296	    (hV : IsAffineOpen V) :
297	    Γ(X.left, V) ⊗[k] A ≃+*
298	      Γ((X ⊗ overSpec k A).left, (fst X (overSpec k A)).left ⁻¹ᵁ V) :=
299	  Over.sectionsBaseChange X A hV.isCompact hV.isQuasiSeparated
300	
301	theorem Over.sectionsBaseChange_tmul_one {V : X.left.Opens}
302	    (hV : IsCompact (V : Set X.left)) (hV' : IsQuasiSeparated (V : Set X.left))
303	    (s : Γ(X.left, V)) :
304	    Over.sectionsBaseChange X A hV hV' (s ⊗ₜ 1) =
305	      (fst X (overSpec k A)).left.appLE V ((fst X (overSpec k A)).left ⁻¹ᵁ V) le_rfl s :=
306	  congr($((CommRingCat.isPushout_tensorProduct k Γ(X.left, V) A).inl_isoIsPushout_hom _ _
307	    (Over.isPushout_algebraMap_sections X A hV hV')).hom s)
308	
309	theorem Over.sectionsBaseChange_one_tmul {V : X.left.Opens}
310	    (hV : IsCompact (V : Set X.left)) (hV' : IsQuasiSeparated (V : Set X.left)) (a : A) :
311	    Over.sectionsBaseChange X A hV hV' (1 ⊗ₜ a) =
312	      ((Scheme.ΓSpecIso (.of A)).inv ≫
313	        (snd X (overSpec k A)).left.appLE ⊤ ((fst X (overSpec k A)).left ⁻¹ᵁ V)
314	          (le_top.trans (Scheme.Hom.preimage_top (snd X (overSpec k A)).left).ge)) a :=
315	  congr($((CommRingCat.isPushout_tensorProduct k Γ(X.left, V) A).inr_isoIsPushout_hom _ _
316	    (Over.isPushout_algebraMap_sections X A hV hV')).hom a)
317	
318	/-- The base-change equivalence on a pure tensor: `s ⊗ a` goes to the product of the
319	pullback of `s` along the first projection and the pullback of `a` along the second. -/
320	theorem Over.sectionsBaseChange_tmul {V : X.left.Opens}
321	    (hV : IsCompact (V : Set X.left)) (hV' : IsQuasiSeparated (V : Set X.left))
322	    (s : Γ(X.left, V)) (a : A) :
323	    Over.sectionsBaseChange X A hV hV' (s ⊗ₜ a) =
324	      (fst X (overSpec k A)).left.appLE V ((fst X (overSpec k A)).left ⁻¹ᵁ V) le_rfl s *
325	      ((Scheme.ΓSpecIso (.of A)).inv ≫
326	        (snd X (overSpec k A)).left.appLE ⊤ ((fst X (overSpec k A)).left ⁻¹ᵁ V)
327	          (le_top.trans (Scheme.Hom.preimage_top (snd X (overSpec k A)).left).ge)) a := by
328	  have h : (s ⊗ₜ[k] a : Γ(X.left, V) ⊗[k] A) = (s ⊗ₜ 1) * (1 ⊗ₜ a) := by
329	    rw [Algebra.TensorProduct.tmul_mul_tmul, mul_one, one_mul]
330	  rw [h, map_mul, Over.sectionsBaseChange_tmul_one, Over.sectionsBaseChange_one_tmul]
331	
332	set_option backward.isDefEq.respectTransparency false in
333	/-- **Naturality of the base-change equivalence in the open**: for `W ≤ V` (both qcqs),
334	restricting the base-changed section is base-changing the restriction. The map on tensor
335	products is `Algebra.TensorProduct.map` of the restriction `Over.resAlgHom` and the
336	identity of `A`. -/
337	theorem Over.sectionsBaseChange_naturality {V W : X.left.Opens}
338	    (hV : IsCompact (V : Set X.left)) (hV' : IsQuasiSeparated (V : Set X.left))
339	    (hW : IsCompact (W : Set X.left)) (hW' : IsQuasiSeparated (W : Set X.left))
340	    (hWV : W ≤ V) (x : Γ(X.left, V) ⊗[k] A) :
341	    (X ⊗ overSpec k A).left.presheaf.map
342	        (homOfLE (show (fst X (overSpec k A)).left ⁻¹ᵁ W ≤
343	          (fst X (overSpec k A)).left ⁻¹ᵁ V by gcongr)).op
344	      (Over.sectionsBaseChange X A hV hV' x) =
345	      Over.sectionsBaseChange X A hW hW'
346	        (Algebra.TensorProduct.map (Over.resAlgHom X hWV) (AlgHom.id k A) x) := by
347	  induction x with
348	  | zero => simp only [map_zero]
349	  | add x y hx hy => simp only [map_add, hx, hy]
350	  | tmul s a =>
351	    rw [Algebra.TensorProduct.map_tmul, AlgHom.coe_id, id_eq, Over.resAlgHom_apply,
352	      Over.sectionsBaseChange_tmul, Over.sectionsBaseChange_tmul, map_mul]
353	    congr 1
354	    · rw [← CommRingCat.comp_apply, Scheme.Hom.appLE_map, ← CommRingCat.comp_apply,
355	        Scheme.Hom.map_appLE]
356	    · rw [← CommRingCat.comp_apply, Category.assoc, Scheme.Hom.appLE_map]
357	
358	end TensorFace
359	
360	end AlgebraicGeometry

universe u

open CategoryTheory Limits MonoidalCategory CartesianMonoidalCategory TensorProduct

namespace AlgebraicGeometry

section Transition

variable {k : Type u} [Field k] (C : Over (Spec (.of k)))
  {K₁ K₂ : Type u} [Field K₁] [Algebra k K₁] [Field K₂] [Algebra k K₂]

/-! ## The raw pushout square of section rings -/

/-- **Base change of sections along the transition, raw form.** For an affine open
`V ⊆ (C ⊗ overSpec k K₁).left`, the square of section rings

```
Γ(Spec K₁, ⊤) ⟶ Γ(C_{K₁}, V)
     |               |
     ↓               ↓
Γ(Spec K₂, ⊤) ⟶ Γ(C_{K₂}, π ⁻¹ᵁ V)
```

(top = second projection of `C_{K₁}`, left = `Spec.map φ`, bottom = the transition `π`,
right = second projection of `C_{K₂}`) is a pushout of commutative rings. No flatness is
needed in the affine case; the pasted square `isPullback_baseFieldTransition` feeds the
engine `isIso_pushoutSection_of_isAffineOpen`. -/
theorem Over.isPushout_transitionSections_of_isAffineOpen (φ : K₁ →ₐ[k] K₂)
    {V : (C ⊗ overSpec k K₁).left.Opens} (hV : IsAffineOpen V) :
    IsPushout
/-! ## The comparison isomorphism (tensor-product form) -/

section TensorIso

variable [Algebra K₁ K₂] [IsScalarTower k K₁ K₂]

/-- **Base change of sections along the base-field transition** (SB-2), as an isomorphism of
`CommRingCat`: `Γ(C_{K₁}, V) ⊗[K₁] K₂ ≅ Γ(C_{K₂}, π ⁻¹ᵁ V)` for an affine open `V`, with
`φ = IsScalarTower.toAlgHom k K₁ K₂`. Built from the algebra-corner pushout square and
`CommRingCat.isPushout_tensorProduct`. -/
noncomputable def Over.transitionSectionsBaseChangeIso {V : (C ⊗ overSpec k K₁).left.Opens}
    (hV : IsAffineOpen V) :
    CommRingCat.of (Γ((C ⊗ overSpec k K₁).left, V) ⊗[K₁] K₂) ≅
      Γ((C ⊗ overSpec k K₂).left,
        (C ◁ Over.overSpecMap (IsScalarTower.toAlgHom k K₁ K₂)).left ⁻¹ᵁ V) :=
  (CommRingCat.isPushout_tensorProduct K₁ Γ((C ⊗ overSpec k K₁).left, V) K₂).isoIsPushout _ _
    (Over.isPushout_algebraMap_transitionSections C (IsScalarTower.toAlgHom k K₁ K₂) hV)

/-- **Base change of sections along the base-field transition** (SB-2, brick), as a ring
equivalence: `Γ(C_{K₁}, V) ⊗[K₁] K₂ ≃+* Γ(C_{K₂}, π ⁻¹ᵁ V)` for an affine open `V`. On a pure
tensor `s ⊗ a` it is the product of the pullback of `s` along `π` and the pullback of `a`
along the second projection (`transitionSectionsBaseChange_tmul`). The `K₁`-algebra structure
on `Γ(C_{K₁}, V)` is the second-projection `baseChangeSectionsAlgebra`. -/
noncomputable def Over.transitionSectionsBaseChange {V : (C ⊗ overSpec k K₁).left.Opens}
    (hV : IsAffineOpen V) :
    Γ((C ⊗ overSpec k K₁).left, V) ⊗[K₁] K₂ ≃+*
      Γ((C ⊗ overSpec k K₂).left,
        (C ◁ Over.overSpecMap (IsScalarTower.toAlgHom k K₁ K₂)).left ⁻¹ᵁ V) :=
  (Over.transitionSectionsBaseChangeIso C hV).commRingCatIsoToRingEquiv

theorem Over.transitionSectionsBaseChange_tmul_one {V : (C ⊗ overSpec k K₁).left.Opens}
    (hV : IsAffineOpen V) (s : Γ((C ⊗ overSpec k K₁).left, V)) :
    Over.transitionSectionsBaseChange C hV (s ⊗ₜ 1) =
      (C ◁ Over.overSpecMap (IsScalarTower.toAlgHom k K₁ K₂)).left.appLE V
        ((C ◁ Over.overSpecMap (IsScalarTower.toAlgHom k K₁ K₂)).left ⁻¹ᵁ V) le_rfl s :=
  congr($((CommRingCat.isPushout_tensorProduct K₁ Γ((C ⊗ overSpec k K₁).left, V)
    K₂).inl_isoIsPushout_hom _ _
    (Over.isPushout_algebraMap_transitionSections C (IsScalarTower.toAlgHom k K₁ K₂) hV)).hom s)

theorem Over.transitionSectionsBaseChange_one_tmul {V : (C ⊗ overSpec k K₁).left.Opens}
    (hV : IsAffineOpen V) (a : K₂) :
    Over.transitionSectionsBaseChange C hV (1 ⊗ₜ a) =
      ((Scheme.ΓSpecIso (.of K₂)).inv ≫
        (snd C (overSpec k K₂)).left.appLE ⊤
          ((C ◁ Over.overSpecMap (IsScalarTower.toAlgHom k K₁ K₂)).left ⁻¹ᵁ V)
          (le_top.trans (Scheme.Hom.preimage_top (snd C (overSpec k K₂)).left).ge)) a :=
  congr($((CommRingCat.isPushout_tensorProduct K₁ Γ((C ⊗ overSpec k K₁).left, V)
    K₂).inr_isoIsPushout_hom _ _
    (Over.isPushout_algebraMap_transitionSections C (IsScalarTower.toAlgHom k K₁ K₂) hV)).hom a)

/-- The base-change equivalence on a pure tensor: `s ⊗ a` goes to the product of the pullback
of `s` along the transition `π` and the pullback of `a` along the second projection. -/
theorem Over.transitionSectionsBaseChange_tmul {V : (C ⊗ overSpec k K₁).left.Opens}
    (hV : IsAffineOpen V) (s : Γ((C ⊗ overSpec k K₁).left, V)) (a : K₂) :
    Over.transitionSectionsBaseChange C hV (s ⊗ₜ a) =
      (C ◁ Over.overSpecMap (IsScalarTower.toAlgHom k K₁ K₂)).left.appLE V

/-! ## The degree-`d` layer as a `Type`-valued subfunctor -/

variable (C) in
/-- **The degree-`d` layer `pic^d` (worksheet §5 risk 6)**: the classes of `picEt C T` of
degree `d` at *every* field point.  A **subtype**, not a subgroup — for `d ≠ 0` it is a
coset, so it carries no group structure.  This is the shifted target the chart functors
land in. -/
abbrev picDegLayer (d : ℤ) (T : Over (Spec (.of k))) : Type u :=
  {lam : picEt C T // ∀ (K : Type u) [Field K] [Algebra k K] (t : overSpec k K ⟶ T),
    degAt lam t = d}

variable (C) in
/-- **The degree-`d` layer functor** `pic^d : (Over (Spec k))ᵒᵖ ⥤ Type u`: the
`Type`-valued subfunctor of `picEtFunctor C` cut out by the degree-`d` condition.
Contravariant, no group structure. -/
def picDegLayerFunctor (d : ℤ) : (Over (Spec (.of k)))ᵒᵖ ⥤ Type u where
  obj T := picDegLayer C d T.unop
  map {T T'} g := ↾fun (lam : picDegLayer C d T.unop) =>
    (⟨picEtMap C g.unop lam.1, fun K _ _ t => by
      rw [degAt_picEtMap]; exact lam.2 K (t ≫ g.unop)⟩ : picDegLayer C d T'.unop)
  map_id T := by

    windowBound π hπ + 2 * (g : ℤ) ≤ ((windowS_choice π hπ g : ℤ) - 1) * windowδ π := by
  have h := windowS_spec_three π hπ g
  have hg : (0 : ℤ) ≤ (g : ℤ) := Int.natCast_nonneg _
  linarith

private theorem windowM_exists (g : ℕ) :
    ∃ M : ℕ, windowBound π hπ + 2 * (g : ℤ)
        + ((g : ℤ) + 2) * ((windowS_choice π hπ g : ℤ) + 1) * windowδ π
      ≤ (M : ℤ) * windowδ π := by
  set U : ℤ := windowBound π hπ + 2 * (g : ℤ)
      + ((g : ℤ) + 2) * ((windowS_choice π hπ g : ℤ) + 1) * windowδ π with hU
  refine ⟨U.toNat, ?_⟩

    le_mul_of_one_le_right (Int.natCast_nonneg _) hδ

        + ((g : ℤ) + 2) * ((windowS_choice π hπ g : ℤ) + 1) * windowδ π
      ≤ (windowM_choice π hπ g : ℤ) * windowδ π :=

## Reusable machinery, summary

`Curve/BaseChangeInstances.lean` (instances on `C_K`) and `Cohomology/H1BaseFieldInvariance.lean` (structure-sheaf `H⁰`/`H¹`/genus invariance) are the two clean, self-contained, `sorry`-free reusable bricks. `Cohomology/SectionsBaseChange.lean` + `TransitionSectionsBaseChange.lean` are the section-level substrate; `DegreeBaseFieldInvariance.lean:462` is the degree keystone. The two friction points for a porter: (a) `relCurve`-vs-`(C ⊗ overSpec k K).left` spelling means the instances don't fire on the `relCurve` def and get re-declared as local instances in at least three files; (b) twisted-sheaf `H¹` base change is only available as a *vanishing* transport, never as an isomorphism, and `χ(C_K)` is threaded as a hypothesis in `WindowFieldTransport` even though `H1BaseFieldInvariance` could discharge it.
